Definition: something scorned; an object of contempt
BiblicalUsage: bûwzâh means something scorned, an object of contempt. It appears once, in Nehemiah among them, and that use is enough to fix its sense.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe bûwzâh, little-used as it is, earns its place in Scripture.
